data.cultural_impact: The name "Sahinur" holds deep cultural significance in Hindu society as it signifies victory and triumph over adversity. It is a name that evokes thoughts of courage, bravery, and strength. It is a name that inspires and encourages individuals to face challenges head-on and emerge victorious.
data.spiritual_significance: On a spiritual level, the name "Sahinur" represents the inner strength and courage that each individual possesses. It is a reminder that no matter what challenges we face in life, we have the ability to overcome them with determination and faith. It is a name that encourages us to tap into our inner resources and draw upon our inner reserves of strength and courage to face the trials and tribulations of life. Ultimately, the name "Sahinur" is a reminder of the power of the human spirit to triumph over adversity and achieve victory in all aspects of life.

historical_references.reference: Sahinur was a famous Hindu general under the rule of the Vijayanagara Empire in the late 16th century. He played a significant role in the Battle of Talikota (1565) against the invading forces of the Deccan sultanate.
historical_references.context: Battle of Talikota against the Deccan sultanate

historical_references.reference: Sahinur was also known for his military prowess during the reign of Emperor Achyutadeva (r. 1542-1545) of the Vijayanagara Empire. He was appointed as the commander of the forces in the southern region and successfully repelled invasions from the Gangas of Orissa and the Keladi chieftains.
historical_references.context: Repelled invasions from the Gangas of Orissa and the Keladi chieftains
